Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes posted C words, machine checks, and rotary motion geometry.

The trial merge with upstream main `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6` is clean. The standard C-axis tests pass. No golden files changed. No UI files changed, so this PR needs no UI screenshots.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/cl/src/cl/rotary.rs:122` — Check the arc subdivision error before you accept the chords. `Move::segments3` uses `arc_chords`, which limits each arc to 1024 chords. Thus, the requested half-tolerance is not a guaranteed bound. The later `split` function divides these straight chords. It cannot restore the original arc. A local test used a radius-1000 mm XY arc, counterclockwise from `(1000, 0, 0)` to `(0, -1000, 0)`. With `tol = 0.001`, `stamp_c` returned success and 4096 moves. An output endpoint had radial error `0.0026472330220030926` mm. This exceeds the requested tolerance and can cut into the part. Subdivide the original arc until the error meets the budget, or refuse it by name when the limit prevents this. Add a regression test that reaches the chord limit.

2. `crates/post/src/machine/direction.rs:105` and `assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps:617` — Prevent overflow in both axis alignment checks. The finite, non-Z vector `[1e200, 0, 1e200]` makes both squared terms infinite. The comparison `Infinity < Infinity` is false, so both checks accept this vector as Z-aligned. A local Rust test got `Ok(1.0)` from `c_z_sense`. A local post test got no warnings and emitted `G01 X20. Z5. C-90. F1272.8`. The machine axis is 45 degrees from Z, so this output does not describe the stated machine motion. Scale the vector before you calculate its length, or refuse an invalid intermediate result. Add regression tests for both checks.

Local verification on the trial merge:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` selected the batch scope because CL changed. I ran the touched suites below locally.
- CL: library 42, `headless_bin` 3, `origin_approach` 5 passed.
- Post: library 59, `script_fanuc_lathe` 17, `lathe_live_feed_cap` 8, `lathe_post_refusals` 11 passed.
- Simulation: `c_axis_fixture` 9 passed.
- App: library 341 passed, 1 ignored; `c_axis_live` 5, `c_axis_live_world` 3, `c_axis_unwind` 7, `machine` 33, `rotary_letter` 3, `setup_sheet` 8 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed. Total baseline results: 554 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored.

Mutation checks:

- Restore the old arc refusal: `an_arc_in_xy_and_a_full_helix_ride_a_c_turn_within_tol` failed. Restore the PR code: the test passed.
- Remove the posted C sign correction: `a_minus_z_c_axis_posts_negated_c` failed. Restore the PR code: the test passed.
- The separate regression assertions for the two findings failed as described above. All temporary tests and mutations were removed.

No GitHub runner was used. Release-only tests, ignored tests, UI tests, and physical control execution were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Arc chord-limit error. `stamp_c` now checks the original arc's chord error budget before accepting subdivision. It refuses by move name when the generated chords cannot meet half tolerance. Pinned by `an_arc_at_the_chord_limit_refuses_before_rotary_splitting`, which reaches the 1024-chord cap on the reported radius-1000 arc.
2. C-axis alignment overflow. Rust and Fanuc Lathe now scale direction vectors before squaring them. Pinned by `c_z_sense_is_independent_of_finite_vector_scale` and `an_overflowing_non_z_c_axis_refuses_without_live_motion`. The reported tilted vector is refused, and the post emits no live G01.

Each of the three checks was independently reverted: its pin went RED. Restoring each fix made its pin GREEN.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` ran the batch fallback: 6901 passed, 0 failed, 65 ignored. Its only failure was a clippy lint in the new test assertion. After correcting that assertion, the pin and the failed-step gate rerun passed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` also passed. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed.

New head: `3d0a5d397a5081a0e86e3b4713aedc701d26ab51`.

Please re-review these fixes. The PR remains a draft.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes posted C words, machine checks, and rotary motion geometry.

Both findings from the previous review are resolved:

- `stamp_c` checks the original arc error before it accepts the generated chords. The radius-1000 regression test reaches the 1024-chord limit and gets a named refusal.
- Rust and the Fanuc Lathe post scale the C direction before they square its components. The reported `[1e200, 0, 1e200]` vector is refused. The post test also checks that no live G01 is emitted.

The trial merge with upstream main `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6` is clean. I checked the rules in that revision of `AGENTS.md`.

Local build and test results:

- CL: library 43, `headless_bin` 3, `origin_approach` 5 passed.
- Post: library 60, `script_fanuc_lathe` 18, `lathe_live_feed_cap` 8, `lathe_post_refusals` 11 passed.
- Simulation: `c_axis_fixture` 9 passed.
- App: library 341 passed, 1 ignored; `c_axis_live` 5, `c_axis_live_world` 3, `c_axis_unwind` 7, `machine` 33, `rotary_letter` 3, `setup_sheet` 8 passed.
- Total: 557 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

I ran three mutation checks separately:

1. Remove the arc error budget check: `an_arc_at_the_chord_limit_refuses_before_rotary_splitting` failed. Restore the check: the test passed.
2. Restore the raw squared norm in Rust: `c_z_sense_is_independent_of_finite_vector_scale` failed. Restore the scale calculation: the test passed.
3. Restore the raw squared norm in the Fanuc post: `an_overflowing_non_z_c_axis_refuses_without_live_motion` failed. Restore the scale calculation: the test passed.

All temporary mutations were removed. No golden files changed. No UI files changed, so before and after screenshots are not required. No scripts, workflows, build hooks, dependencies, or process files changed.

Requested before merge: none.

Test limits: the quick gate plan selected the batch scope because CL changed. This review ran the selected suites above, not the full batch. No GitHub runner was used. Release-only tests, ignored tests, UI tests, and physical control execution were not run. This partial step uses `Refs #33`; the remaining items stay open.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
